name: Roshutsu Kouen Imouto Rape
original_name: 露出公園 妹レイプ
source:
Due to my parents, I live separately with my big brother.
I met my brother today in a park.

He was eager to know how my body grew up since the last time we met
and took away my clothing...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ053649.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
由于父母的原因，我和哥哥分开居住。
今天我在公园遇见了我哥哥。

他很想知道自从我们上次见面以来我的身体长得怎么样了
还拿走了我的衣服…
